sheets.title: Opening Settings › Keybindings on a phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A phone has no key to bind, so its keymap is the Gestures loadout.
sheets.before: the address lands on /settings: General, no key editor, no Keybindings tab
sheets.after: /settings/keybindings opens on the Gestures tab: six rows, each a 44px choice

sheets.title: The Keyboard tab, one tap away — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A phone with a keyboard attached keeps the keymap it had.
sheets.before: no Keyboard tab: the phone never drew the key editor
sheets.after: Keyboard is selected and draws the Keymap panel at phone width

sheets.title: The sheet a finger reads — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Help is the gestures in force, each with what it runs now.
sheets.before: six fixed rows: tap, hold, swipe a row left, swipe right, the + key, the search key
sheets.after: the same six, then one row per bound gesture: two-finger swipes, two-finger tap, shake

sheets.title: Settings › Keybindings with a mouse — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: A mouse lands on the Keyboard loadout; the Gestures tab sits beside it.
sheets.after: tabs Keyboard and Gestures, Keyboard selected, the same Keymap panel

sheets.title: The Gestures tab on a desktop — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: A touch laptop can set its gestures too.
sheets.after: the Gestures panel: a row per gesture, the motion switch where the browser has a sensor
